name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A round image or initials representing a user, with optional status badge and overlapping groups.

classes.name: avatar
classes.description: Avatar container. Holds an or a with initials.

classes.name: avatar__badge
classes.description: A status dot in the bottom corner. Can hold an icon.

variables.name: --avatar-size
variables.description: Width and height of the avatar.

variables.name: --avatar-box-shadow
variables.description: Ring used to separate grouped avatars and badges.

notes: Add the btn class to make the avatar clickable, for example as a dropdown trigger.
